top_critical_findings.title: MFA Not Enforced for Administrative and Console Users
top_critical_findings.finding_detail: Root user and 4 IAM administrator accounts have no active MFA hardware or virtual token enabled.

top_critical_findings.title: S3 Public Access Block Disabled on Storage Buckets
top_critical_findings.finding_detail: Buckets 'pune-esg-disclosure-drafts' and 'pune-esg-smartmeter-telemetry' have block_public_acls and block_public_policy set to false with world-readable ACL grants.

top_critical_findings.title: Security Groups Allow Ingress From 0.0.0.0/0 to SSH (Port 22)
top_critical_findings.finding_detail: Default security group and instance security group 'esg-web-sg' allow unrestricted inbound TCP traffic on port 22 from any IPv4 address.

top_critical_findings.title: RDS Database Instance Is Publicly Accessible and Unencrypted
top_critical_findings.finding_detail: PostgreSQL instance 'esg-analytics-db' has publicly_accessible=true and storage_encrypted=false.

top_critical_findings.title: Multi-Region CloudTrail Trail Not Configured
top_critical_findings.finding_detail: No active multi-region trail exists to record management events; log file validation is disabled.

top_critical_findings.title: AWS GuardDuty Threat Detection Disabled
top_critical_findings.finding_detail: GuardDuty detector is not enabled in ap-south-1 primary operating region.

top_critical_findings.title: Absence of CloudWatch Alarms for Root Account Usage
top_critical_findings.finding_detail: No metric filter or SNS notification configured to alert on root credentials usage.
